_note: How tools/motion.py talks to Kimodo, built from source by `python setup/setup.py kimodo` (uv, no Docker) and run through tools/kimodo.py, which keeps every cache in KIMODO_HOME. cmd: the generation command ({py} is this Python, {out} an output stem: Kimodo writes {out}.npz). npz: the keys of Kimodo's NPZ (posed_joints [T, 77, 3], Y up, +Z forward, +X the character's left, metres, the joints in Content/Studio/soma77.json's order). joint_map: which SOMA joint stands for each previs joint (poses.json), so blocked poses and generated motions line up; preview also keeps all 77 joints, so the desk drives the whole MHR skeleton (fingers, toes, neck) from them.
